fixture_isolation.policy: Independent reference/candidate dataset reset for each mutating case; no shared mutable DB/storage; fixture IDs resolved separately. Never use real identities or documents.
fixture_isolation.clock: same synthetic comparable timestamps for successful writes and lists
fixture_isolation.file_rules: same allowed bytes/name; upload >10 MiB and invalid extension/content type are synthetic negative fixtures

operation_fixture_sets.category_pagination: Separate case dataset with 21 synthetic categories, deterministic order/name; not added to original 25-item read dataset by default
operation_fixture_sets.mutation_reset: Start each case from a clean equivalent copy; materialize created/new IDs during its own steps, no fixed DB numeric IDs

manifest_summary.scope: full proposed INS-A/INS-B; per-group counts explicit; no executable loader or accepted baseline
manifest_summary.capture_point_note: Case-viewport combinations are not PNG count; cases with multiple capture_points require evidence for each point.

fixture_materialization.read_cases: Use fixtures.program/categories/items only: exactly25 read items. Do not add operation-only items or21-category pagination dataset to these cases.
fixture_materialization.operation_cases: Reset an independent equivalent pair per case; merge only referenced operation_fixture_sets entities by ref. Existing refs extend matching base specs, never duplicate database records.
fixture_materialization.program_category_rule: Every category has explicit program_ref; every item has program_ref and nullable category_ref. Resolve against the same per-case logical registry; category must belong to item program.
fixture_materialization.missing_reference_rule: Stop fixture preparation on unresolved ref; never guess a program, default a role or use production objects.
fixture_materialization.files: Use matching synthetic bytes/content_ref and names in each isolated storage. Honor present_in_storage=false negative case; no actual files generated by this manifest.
fixture_materialization.roles: Create nine non-superuser role fixtures with only declared permissions and existing profile_default; no implicit group grants.
